title: Sampling of basement fluids via Circulation Obviation Retrofit Kits (CORKs) for dissolved gases, fluid fixation at the seafloor, and the characterization of organic carbon
author: Lin, Hsieh, et al.

steps.title: Configure sampling bottles and valves
steps.instruction: Install 500 mL Tedlar bags into McLane RAS bottles, MVBS, or LVBS and optionally connect them to the 25‑port McLane valve manifolds for fluid collection.

steps.title: Collect basement fluid at seafloor
steps.instruction: Deploy the Mobile GeoMICROBE (MGM) on the ROV Jason elevator, start the pre‑programmed pump sequence, and draw fluid into the 500 mL Tedlar bags using the McLane pump (or Mega pump) while recording sensor data.

steps.title: Filter suspended particles
steps.instruction: Pass the collected fluid through a pre‑combusted 47 mm GF/F filter (or 25 mm GF/F), then optionally filter through a 47 mm polycarbonate filter (0.2 µm) or a Sterivex filter (0.2 µm) to retain suspended particles.

steps.title: Extract dissolved organic matter
steps.instruction: Route the filtrate (already passed through the pre‑combusted GF/F) through a custom‑built Teflon column packed with hydrophobic XAD‑8 or Bond Elut ENV resin; use the McLane pump to maintain a flow rate of 50–125 mL min⁻¹, ensuring at least 2 min contact time; column volume must be between 125 mL and 500 mL.

steps.title: Secure hardware on elevator
steps.instruction: Mount RAS bottles, filters, and XAD columns on a custom polyethylene rack or a heavy‑duty milk crate that is bolted to the Jason elevator platform.

steps.title: Recover samples and check quality
steps.instruction: After retrieval, collect any residual fluid remaining in filter holders, columns, and tubing; analyze these residues for Mg concentration to verify sample integrity.

steps.title: Store XAD column frozen
steps.instruction: Place the XAD column in a -20 °C freezer on the ship or shore laboratory until it can be processed.

steps.title: Elute and prepare organic extract
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen column, rinse it three times its volume with Milli‑Q water to remove salts, then elute the adsorbed organics with HPLC‑grade methanol; rotary‑evaporate the methanol, freeze‑dry the residue, and finally redissolve the dried material in 50 mL ND₄OD for downstream characterization.

steps.title: Fix iron species on seafloor
steps.instruction: Immediately after fluid collection into a 500 mL bag, add Ferrozine reagent to fix ferrous ion and total dissolved iron, minimizing oxidation before the bag is sealed.

steps.title: Optional seafloor incubation with isotopes
steps.instruction: Add stable‑isotope tracers (¹³C‑HCO₃⁻, ¹⁵N‑NH₄⁺, ¹⁵N‑NO₃⁻) to the 500 mL Tedlar bag; incubate at in‑situ temperature (e.g., 10 °C for North Pond; heating to 65 °C may be required for hotter ridge sites) before recovery.
